recipes.name: French Salad Dressing (French Vinaigrette)
ingredients: 1/4 cup eschalots / French shallots (, finely chopped (Note 1))
1/4 cup red or white wine vinegar ((or sherry or champagne vinegar))
1/2 cup extra virgin olive oil ((or more if you want richer))
1 tbsp eschalots / French shallots (, finely chopped (Note 1))
1 tbsp red or white wine vinegar ((or sherry or champagne vinegar))
instructions: Place ingredients in a jar and shake well until combined. Adjust salt and pepper to taste. Let rest for 5 minutes before using, or keep up to 2 weeks.
Small Batch: Use to dress 4 handfuls of leafy greens.

page_recipe_notes: Recipe Notes: 1. Eschalots in Australia are known as shallots in the US and much of the rest of the world. It is also referred to as a French shallot. They are small onions. They taste more mild than onions, slightly sweeter, and the flesh is more tender so it sort of “dissolves” in sauces and dressings better (if finely chopped). 2. This keeps for up to 2 weeks in the fridge in an airtight jar. Beyond this, the flavour of the eschalot starts to noticeably fade.
